blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Fashion & Luxury — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the fashion & luxury operating unit of Retail & Consumer Goods.

Fashion and luxury sell scarcity, story and service: assortment risk (the size-curve problem), authenticity, clienteling quality and channel consistency. Technology must be invisible — but the intelligence beneath it decides which drops pay.

items: Fake listings, phishing and counterfeit marketplaces unmonitored at scale.
Assortment and buy decisions guess curves; end-of-season markdowns absorb the error.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC, Cloud Security & Posture Management, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Assortment and buy planning, Boutique allocation, Clienteling and CRM) on Achala Sentinel and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — GDPR among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves — prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
Assume breach, plan recovery — resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
marketplace monitoring with takedown evidence (abuse scaled down)
